description: This Java source file defines an exception mapper class 'PlatformRequestBodyItemLimitValidationExceptionMapper' that handles exceptions of type 'PlatformRequestBodyItemLimitValidationException' and converts them into HTTP responses with a BAD REQUEST status. It is part of the Fineract project infrastructure for exception handling, specifically for request body item limit validation issues.

classes.name: PlatformRequestBodyItemLimitValidationExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS ExceptionMapper that handles 'PlatformRequestBodyItemLimitValidationException' and produces a JSON response indicating a validation error.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a 'PlatformRequestBodyItemLimitValidationException' into an HTTP 400 BAD REQUEST response with a standardized error body.
